bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
echo "GAYBBS_BRANCH_AUDIT"
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
git worktree list --porcelain | grep -E '^(worktree|HEAD|branch) ' | head -75
echo "UNTRACKED_WORKTREES:"
find .worktrees -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null | head -25 || true
echo "LINK_DEPLOY_CANDIDATES"
for path in artifacts/bot/src/bot/linkInlineHandlers.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/linkInlineShare.ts artifacts/bot/src/services/linkRichPreview.ts; do
 if test -f "$path"; then echo "$path=PRESENT"; else echo "$path=ABSENT"; fi
done
echo "COMPOSE_SUMMARY"
docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml config --services 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
echo "GAYBBS_BRANCH_AUDIT_END"
